rules: Envelope bytes and every referenced artifact identity are independently re-hashed on verification.
The envelope records source semantic acceptance separately from executable preservation.
Current executable preservation remains not-established unless a later evidence class proves or independently validates it.
The envelope is audit-record-only and can never mint CheckedCoreCapability, CertifiedSource capability, cache authority or release acceptance.
Production build receipts bind the exact envelope identity and emit the envelope beside the executable evidence.
